test.create_query: CREATE TABLE adaptive_short_circuit (b0 UInt8, b1 UInt8, b2 UInt8, b3 UInt8, sel UInt8, s1 String, s2 String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO adaptive_short_circuit SELECT rand(1) % 2, rand(2) % 2, rand(3) % 2, rand(4) % 2, rand(5) % 100 = 0, repeat(toString(number % 10), 32), repeat(toString(number % 7), 32) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(if(b0, and(b1, b2, b3), 0)) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(if(b0, and(b1, b2, b3), 0)) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_adaptive_short_circuit_lazy_execution = 1
SELECT sum(or(b0, and(b1, b2), and(b2, b3))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(or(b0, and(b1, b2), and(b2, b3))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_adaptive_short_circuit_lazy_execution = 1
SELECT sum(and(b0, compareSubstrings(s1, s2, 0, 0, 32))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(and(b0, compareSubstrings(s1, s2, 0, 0, 32))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_adaptive_short_circuit_lazy_execution = 1
SELECT sum(and(sel, compareSubstrings(s1, s2, 0, 0, 32))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(and(sel, compareSubstrings(s1, s2, 0, 0, 32))) FROM adaptive_short_circuit FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_adaptive_short_circuit_lazy_execution = 1
